title: Capture a twelve-cell pack's shared spring preload with a cross-key
instruction: Seat the pressure plate on the twelve loaded cells, compress their terminal springs, insert the retaining cross-key, and release both hands with all twelve contacts held stable.
context: Pack closure requires preserving twelve spring contacts while one hand maintains pressure and the other captures the preload with a cross-key.

limitations: Rigid contact shoes approximate spring terminals; conductivity is inferred from orientation, seating and measured spring compression.
Pack preload is mechanically captured by a sliding key. Electrochemistry and terminal corrosion are outside scope.
Contact preload, capture-key insertion and expert execution have not yet been tested in native PhysX.
